Mike Webb, back from a business trip to Singapore, and Rob Harding, who had an excellent run having left his push-bike at home for a change and taken the tube from New Cross, meant that we had five home in just outside the first quarter of the field.
Rob Harding is getting stronger with each outing while Phil Carstairs was way below his best and suffering from a cold which really should have stopped him running.
